public_payload.normalized_proposition: SaaS AI products almost always include some half-hearted generative addition, such as creating presentations, drafting emails or boilerplate content, all of which can be done for free with ChatGPT, Claude or another LLM.

statement.excerpt: These products almost always include some sort of half-hearted generative addition too — creating presentations or drafting emails or creating boilerplate content, all things that you can do for free with ChatGPT, Claude or whatever other Large Language Model you can find.

from_speaker: creating presentations or drafting emails or creating boilerplate content
all things that you can do for free with ChatGPT, Claude
our_interpretation: The factual claim concerns the prevalence of generic content generation among SaaS AI add-ons and the availability of those tasks through free chatbots.
I read 'almost always' as nearly universal, without inventing a numerical cutoff.
'Half-hearted' is an opinion and is not separately scored.
The target is the product landscape at publication on September 26, 2024. Earlier announcements are context unless they establish availability at that date.
Creating presentation content and producing a finished presentation file are distinct capabilities; the wording does not distinguish them.
criteria.support_condition: A representative inventory of contemporary SaaS AI add-ons establishes that nearly all offered the listed kinds of content generation, and contemporary free chatbot capabilities cover those tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative inventory establishes substantial exceptions, or contemporary capability evidence shows that the claimed tasks could not be performed with the named free alternatives.
